sampling_plan.method: simple random sampling without replacement; normal-approximation planning
sampling_plan.scope: Finite stock-pool binary proportion, not model-return confidence or power.
sampling_plan.frame: Deduplicated Shanghai/Shenzhen A shares, excluding ST and delisting names.

benchmark: Daily equal-weight of the same stock pool, before transaction costs; not CSI 300.

model_diagnostics.method: PCA (95% train variance) + SVD ridge + historical EWMA RMS
model_diagnostics.selection: Highest validation mean daily Spearman IC; MSE breaks ties.

turnover_control.selection: Highest validation net return; lower turnover and then smaller buffer break ties.

notes: Same source prices, pool, splits, embargo, costs and weight cap as source_experiment; the buffered variant changes holding selection.
Historical feature summaries and EWMA replace the deep model; this is an algorithm comparison, not a pure architecture ablation.
The already-inspected test interval is exploratory; confirmation requires fresh unseen dates.
published_artifacts_note: Local input/checkpoint hashes refer to the actual local run. downloaded_stock_pool.csv lists successfully downloaded stocks; sampled_stock_pool.csv, when present, retains the random draw including missing histories. Market bars, factors and checkpoints remain local.
limitations: Current-universe and as-of-download adjustment biases are not removed by random sampling.
Research execution omits suspension, price-limit and tax constraints.
Single seed and reused test dates: exploratory, not independent confirmation.
